SELECT cm.FullName, cm.Id
FROM car_makers cm
JOIN model_list ml ON ml.Maker = cm.Id
GROUP BY cm.Id, cm.FullName
HAVING COUNT(ml.Model) > 3;
FINAL SQL:
SELECT cm.FullName, cm.Id
FROM car_makers cm
JOIN model_list ml ON ml.Maker = cm.Id
GROUP BY cm.Id, cm.FullName
HAVING COUNT(ml.Model) > 3;
